accepted.condition: Sort out concerns about weakening the National Firearms Act and the excise tax or adopt the amendments offered to address them.
accepted.quote: Unless we can sort this out, or unless some of the amendments that are being offered today are adopted, I'm going to have to be a ``no'' and urge the rest of the committee to be a ``no'' on this.

_demand.name: Adopt amendments resolving NFA and excise tax issues
